description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Save a domain name to the user's GearHost account to decide on later. It is checked with the domain registry now and every time the saved list is looked at. Saving does NOT register, hold or reserve the name with the registry and costs nothing: anyone can still register it until the user buys it. The user buys it themselves in their GearHost account (Domains). Use when the user likes a name but is not ready to buy, or asks to keep it in mind. Returns structuredContent { status, domain, availability, already_saved, saved_count, where }.

domain.description: The full domain to save, e.g. "harborgrind.com".

note.description: Optional short note shown with it, e.g. "for the coffee shop site". Max 200 chars.

name: save_domain

availability.description: available, taken or unknown (the registry did not answer; not the same as available).

where.description: Where the user sees the saved list.

title: Save domain for later
